scope: Derived current geometry coverage audit using only frozen Census TIGER/Line 2025 coastline and frozen SIGE Coastal Shoreline manifestations

derivation.rule: polygonization is a derived discovery geometry only; no source line or derived polygon is promoted to canonical insular identity

interpretation.coverage_only: representative-point containment is coverage evidence only, not identity proof
interpretation.misses: a point outside derived polygons does not prove feature or geometry absence
interpretation.sige_limitation: the frozen SIGE shoreline manifestation is known from source metadata to omit smaller nearby islands/cays, so failure to cover a GNIS point is not negative identity evidence
